landing_cefr.title: CEFR (Multi-level) Exam Structure
landing_cefr.subtitle: Complete Speaking simulation aligned with official State Testing Centre (UzBMB / DTM) requirements
landing_cefr.part1_desc: Answer 4-5 quick, natural questions about personal life, interests, and familiar everyday topics.
landing_cefr.part2_desc: Compare 2 pictures or situations, identify differences, and propose a solution (1 min prep, 2 mins speech).
landing_cefr.part3_desc: Engage in in-depth discussion on complex social, academic, or philosophical topics with structured arguments.
landing_cefr.b1_desc: Can express opinions on familiar topics. Basic grammar and vocabulary sufficient for everyday communication.
landing_cefr.b2_desc: Understands complex ideas and speaks fluently. The key benchmark for university admissions and employment bonuses.
landing_cefr.c1_desc: Professional, academic, and near-native proficiency across demanding and nuanced discussion topics.

landing_scoring.title: How Does AI Evaluate Your Speaking?
landing_scoring.subtitle: Trained on official CEFR and UzBMB rubrics to evaluate every sentence objectively in real time
landing_scoring.fluency_desc: Speech continuity, natural pacing, logical transitions, and effective use of discourse markers.
landing_scoring.lexical_desc: Range of vocabulary, synonyms, idioms, academic collocations, and contextual precision.
landing_scoring.grammar_desc: Use of complex sentence structures, accurate verb tenses, and minimal syntax errors.
landing_scoring.pronunciation_desc: Clear phoneme articulation, natural word stress, intonation contours, and intelligibility.
landing_scoring.report_desc: Receive full transcripts, mistake breakdowns, and level predictions immediately after testing.

landing_faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
landing_faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about CEFR Multi-level exams and Multitest.uz
landing_faq.q1: Can I take free mock tests on Multitest.uz?
landing_faq.a1: Yes! Simply create an account to access open and free CEFR and IELTS Speaking mock tests directly from your browser or mobile app.
landing_faq.q2: How accurate is the AI scoring compared to real UzBMB examiners?
landing_faq.a2: Our AI model is calibrated with thousands of test recordings using official UzBMB and CEFR criteria, delivering over 95% scoring accuracy.
landing_faq.q3: How does the Speaking test flow (Part 1, Part 2, Part 3)?
landing_faq.a3: Just like the real exam: Part 1 asks instant short questions; Part 2 displays pictures with 1 min prep and 2 mins recording; Part 3 features in-depth analytical questions.
landing_faq.q4: When will I receive my score and analysis?
landing_faq.a4: Once your audio uploads, our AI evaluates your speech within 60-90 seconds and produces a full breakdown by criteria.
landing_faq.q5: Can I use the Telegram bot?
landing_faq.a5: Yes! Open @MultitestUzBot to log in via Telegram WebApp or start testing directly from your phone.

guide.view_instructions: View instructions for this question type

multiple_choice.title: Multiple Choice (Single answer)
multiple_choice.desc: Multiple options are given, only 1 option is correct.
multiple_choice.step2: Add options one by one or paste them using 'Smart Paste'.
multiple_choice.step3: Select the radio button next to the correct option.
multiple_choice.example: A) Option 1 | B) Option 2 (1 is correct)

multiple_response.title: Multiple Response (Multiple answers)
multiple_response.desc: User selects 2 or more correct options (e.g. Choose TWO letters).
multiple_response.step1: Enter question text (e.g. Which TWO reasons are mentioned?).
multiple_response.step2: Add options and mark the checkbox for ALL correct answers.

true_false.title: True / False / Not Given
true_false.desc: Task to identify whether statements agree with factual information in the text.
true_false.step1: Enter the statement in the question prompt.
true_false.step2: Select the correct answer from 'True', 'False', or 'Not Given' cards below.

yes_no.title: Yes / No / Not Given
yes_no.desc: Task to identify whether statements agree with the views/claims of the writer.
yes_no.step1: Enter the writer's claim or view in the question prompt.
yes_no.step2: Select the correct answer from 'Yes', 'No', or 'Not Given' cards below.

fill_blank.title: Fill in the Blank (Sentence completion)
fill_blank.desc: User types the correct word/number into the blank space.
fill_blank.step2: Enter the target answer word into the 'Correct Answer' field.
fill_blank.step3: Case-insensitivity and alternative answers (/ or |) are automatically handled.

matching.title: Matching (Headings / Features / Information)
matching.desc: Task to match questions with correct option letters (A, B, C...).
matching.step1: 1. When creating Section, specify options range in 'from_option' and 'to_option' (e.g. A to F).
matching.step2: 2. Select the correct letter (A, B, C...) from the list for each question.
matching.warning: If option range (A-F) is not defined in Section, answers cannot be selected in questions!

essay.title: Essay (Writing Task)
essay.desc: User writes an essay or text response.
essay.step1: Write the task prompt and instructions.
essay.step2: A writing area with a live word counter will be provided to the user.

complete_section.title: Complete Section (Note / Summary Completion)
complete_section.desc: Insert gaps as { correct_answer } directly into the text. The system automatically converts them into questions.
complete_section.step1: 1. Write { answer } for each gap in the section text (e.g. { caves }).
complete_section.step2: 2. For multiple acceptable answers, separate with '/' or '|' (e.g. { 14000 / 14,000 } or { stone / stones }).
complete_section.step3: 3. Verify all detected questions in the 'Live Questions Detector' below.
complete_section.example: Excavations inside { caves } revealed axes made of { stone / stones } dating from around { 11700 / 11,700 } years ago.

drag_and_drop.title: Drag and Drop
drag_and_drop.desc: Drag words/phrases from the options pool into the blank spaces in the text.
drag_and_drop.step1: 1. Write gaps in text as { correct_word }.
drag_and_drop.step2: 2. Add extra distractor options under 'Incorrect Options' after creating the section.
drag_and_drop.example: Axes were made out of { stone }.
